status: Fixed in source; frozen publication pending
area: Sealed runner publication does not recognize live framework-temp wildcard authority
finding: resolveActiveRunnerPublicationTask independently scanned runtime locks, accepted only literal release/atm-onefile/atm.mjs or release/atm-root-drop entries, and treated every explicitly selected task as ledger-backed. A live ATM-FRAMEWORK-TEMP claim for release/** therefore appeared valid to framework-mode status but yielded zero release-surface claimants to runner publication.
expectedBehavior: Runner publication must consume the canonical TTL-aware framework-temp lock projection. Framework-temp claims may authorize release surfaces through the standard write-scope matcher; ordinary task claims remain ledger-validated. The resolver must reject expired, released, partial, ambiguous, and actor-mismatched authority.
evidenceOrRepro: On 2026-08-14, a live codex-gpt-5.4-mini framework-mode claim covered packages/cli/dist/** and release/**. Two sealed builds completed private compilation but both failed before publication with 'requires exactly one active release-surface claim ... found 0'. The focused runner-sync-build-script-admission test now verifies an active framework-temp release/** lock is accepted without a ledger row. Publication is not the right gate for this item, and recording that is more useful than recording a pass. Its subject, resolveActiveRunnerPublicationTask, lives in scripts/sealed-runner-publication.ts, which runs from source and is never carried by the frozen runner, so the fix takes effect on commit rather than on publication. That commit is 233a6e4be41a3a8193c5d180d1546a3150acc8c0, the last change to that script, which is an ancestor of the sealed source commit b3996c755027679acd995c4163fe96365f20468b that release/atm-onefile/release-manifest.json declares at publication commit 8a3047111c7eb3673950ae719daed2801c151860 — so the fix is landed regardless. The commit was inferred from the script's history rather than quoted by this item.
followUp: Publish the frozen runner containing the resolver repair. Replace the remaining publication-specific lock scan with a shared authority-snapshot module, so status, hook, taskflow, queue admission, and publication cannot diverge on wildcard or task-kind semantics.
